criteria_outcomes.criterion: Map capabilities to needs without changing the stipulated need text.
Preserve record_id, need, capability_id, and coverage in coverage output.

reviews.decision_reason: Downstream coverage mapping preserved the handoff need values it received, tolerated missing capability matches, and produced one coverage row per retained record. The all-none coverage is explained by the upstream needs handoff values, not by this boundary changing them.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Order unsupported needs first and otherwise preserve upstream ranking.

reviews.decision_reason: Prioritization consumed coverage and evidence_sources, marked non-direct coverage as unsupported, attached upstream ranks by record_id, and ordered unsupported records by upstream rank.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Produce deterministic top-need recommendation and decision from first ranked record.

reviews.decision_reason: Synthesis retained eight ranked priorities and built the recommendation from the first ranked record, producing decision prioritize and top_need s01 from the supplied priorities.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Preserve record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight fields.

reviews.decision_reason: Root cause: selected demand rows did not preserve the corpus need text. The upstream select_demand output replaced each need with its source_id value, yielding needs s01 through s08 instead of the stipulated need phrases.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Normalize selected evidence to required columns and bounded index window.

reviews.decision_reason: Normalization retained the selected rows, required columns, allowed record identifiers, and bounded eight-row window. It propagated the already-mutated need values but did not introduce the mutation.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Assemble ranked source provenance with deterministic ordering.
Preserve record_id, source_id, source_weight, and rank.

reviews.decision_reason: Provenance assembly ranked all eight normalized rows deterministically by demand score and record_id, preserving record_id, source_id, source_weight, and rank in evidence_sources.
